title: FC 3319: First Responder Box
officialText:
3319.1 First responder box.

An approved lock box shall be provided for first responder use.

5601.5.1.1

Such box shall contain all keys required to obtain access to the construction site and operate the hoist; the pre-fire plan; permits; logbooks; and such other documents required by this code or the rules to be maintained on the premises. Such box shall be in an approved location and shall be openable by use of a citywide standard key.
